notes.title: Pink Noise is LIVE on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
[p][b]It's time! [/b]The wait is over, [b]Pink Noise[/b] is now on Kickstarter! 🎉

We’re on the final stretch before release, and now is the perfect moment to join us, support our [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pink-noise/pink-noise-0"]Kickstarter campaign[/url]
[/p][p][b]Here’s what’s waiting for you in the campaign:[/b][/p][p]🔸 [b]Early Bird[/b]. Get [i]PINK NOISE[/i] on Steam copy for just [b]$9[/b] along with additional bonuses. This reward tier will only be available during the first 48 hours, a great chance to support the project at a low price.[/p][p]🔸 [b]Exclusive digital rewards[/b]. From artbooks and the soundtrack to opportunities to leave your mark on the game. Several of these rewards have limited quantities, so make sure to grab yours.[/p][p]🔸 [b]35 days to reach our goal[/b]. That’s how long our campaign will run. Every day will bring us closer to release and new possibilities for the project.[/p][p]🔸 [b]Early backers work wonders[/b]. The first day or two of a campaign determine its visibility and success. The more active you are in the beginning, the higher the chances that the whole world will hear about [i]Pink Noise[/i].[/p][p]🔸 [b]Community & behind the scenes[/b]. Throughout the campaign, we’ll be answering your questions and posting regular updates.
[/p][p]Join us on this exciting journey into the world of [i]indie game development[/i] and become a part of [i]Pink Noise[/i]’s story!
[/p][p]With love,
Somber Games [/p]

notes.title: We're getting ready to launch on Kickstarter
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We’ve come a long way and now we're finally ready to invite you to become a part of Pink Noise.[/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate the upcoming Kickstarter launch, we've updated the demo:[/p][p]🔸 the English script has been professionally edited and now reads much smoother and more naturally;[/p][p]🔸 several scenes have been expanded to deepen the story and enhance immersion;[/p][p]🔸 background art for the street area has been improved, various issues have been fixed, and the arcade mini-game gameplay has been refined.[/p][p][/p][p]There are lots of exciting surprises and exclusive rewards ahead.[/p][p][/p][p]Whether you become a backer or simply share the project — any support means the world to us ❤️[/p][p][/p][p]👉 Follow the [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pink-noise/pink-noise-0"]Kickstarter page[/url][/p][p][/p][p]With love,[/p][p]Somber Games[/p]

notes.title: Welcome "Pink Noise" to the Visual Novel Fest!
notes.notes:
Hey there! We have some amazing news to share.

Since the launch of the demo, we’ve been actively tracking and fixing bugs. Most importantly, we’ve resolved crashes that could occur during streams (yes, the game was literally devouring RAM, but it's all good now!).

💬 We’ve also created a discussion thread where you can share your thoughts on the game. Your feedback is incredibly important to us!

Play the demo and add Pink Noise to your wishlist so you don’t miss the full release of the first episode this year! ✨

notes.title: "Pink Noise" is taking part in the "Steam Scream" festival!
notes.notes:
"Pink Noise" is joining the much-anticipated "Steam Scream" festival, just in time for Halloween—a true treat for horror fans!

Now’s the perfect time to dive into a mysterious, nightmare-filled story about teenagers whose fates depend on your choices.

Don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist and share your impressions. Happy Halloween!

notes.title: The "Pink Noise" demo is ready for the Steam Next Fest!
The "Pink Noise" demo is available now!
notes.notes:
Hello friends!

We are happy to announce that the long awaited "Pink Noise" demo is now available for download right here on Steam!

What awaits you is:
- Getting to know all the main characters of the story. 
- An exciting retro-style mini-game.
- The first choices hinting at the branching storylines of the full version of the game.
- The beginning of an intriguing story that will form the basis of further episodes.

We look forward to your feedback!
Your feedback is very important to us. We would love to hear your impressions, suggestions or bug reports.

Ready to dive into the world of nightmares? Download the demo now!

Stay tuned for news and updates on the full release.

Best wishes,
Somber Games.
